card.summary: A fast, SEO-optimized software developer portfolio built with Next.js 16 and .NET Web API.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional portfolios lacked SEO-friendly project pages and smooth project navigation.
caseStudy.solution: Implemented App Router, intercepting routes, and modal project details with SEO-friendly full pages.
caseStudy.result: Achieved Lighthouse SEO scores above 95 and improved project exploration UX.
